title_zh: 京张验真公地场景矩阵

scenarios.name_zh: 多模态来源登记与验真受理
scenarios.users_zh: 内容平台、媒体、公共机构、创作者
scenarios.users_en: platforms, media, public institutions and creators
scenarios.workflow_zh: 登记来源声明—校验签名与编辑历史—检测异常—人工复核—出具分级收据
scenarios.workflow_en: register claim - verify signatures and edit history - detect anomalies - human review - issue a graded receipt
scenarios.output_zh: 可撤销验真收据与证据包
scenarios.output_en: revocable verification receipt and evidence bundle
scenarios.success: every intake records source, version, purpose, owner, expiry and unresolved status; field service-time baselines remain pending
scenarios.guardrail: Provenance authenticates associations and history, not factual truth; uncertain cases remain unresolved.
scenarios.pause_trigger: material uncertainty, adverse impact or user appeal
scenarios.shutdown_trigger: no named owner, lawful material, safe human route or correction-return coverage
scenarios.recovery_action: pause the result, preserve relevant evidence, conduct human review, correct every affected channel and feed the case into retesting

scenarios.workflow_en: licensed dataset intake - blind test - subgroup error review - adversarial retest - publish model card
